intro.name: Driss Elhail
paragraphs: I’m Driss Elhail, a full-stack developer trained at CodeBoxx. I enjoy turning complex, messy problems into clear, practical solutions that people can use. I work across the stack, from designing databases and building APIs to creating responsive user interfaces.

I contributed to CodeBloggs, a team-built MERN application, and developed this portfolio using React, Supabase, and GitHub Actions. I’m seeking a full-stack developer role where I can contribute to a collaborative team, continue learning from experienced developers, and ship features that solve real problems.

technicalSkills.name: JavaScript & React
technicalSkills.description: Building interactive interfaces with components, hooks, and client-side routing, including this site and the CodeBloggs front end.

technicalSkills.name: Node.js & Express
technicalSkills.description: Designing REST APIs with routing, validation, and authentication, as in the CodeBloggs back end.

technicalSkills.name: Databases
technicalSkills.description: Modeling and querying data in MongoDB and PostgreSQL, and securing it with Supabase row-level security.

technicalSkills.name: Git & GitHub
technicalSkills.description: Working in feature branches, reviewing changes, and automating builds and deploys with GitHub Actions.

softSkills.name: Problem solving
softSkills.description: Breaking hard problems into small steps, sharpened through regular LeetCode practice.

softSkills.name: Teamwork
softSkills.description: Sharing work across a team through clear tasks, branches, and code reviews on CodeBloggs.

softSkills.name: Communication
softSkills.description: Explaining technical work clearly in demos, documentation, and elevator pitches.

softSkills.name: Fast learner
softSkills.description: Picking up new tools quickly at bootcamp pace, from Express to Supabase.
